device.description: 3.3-V 10-bit serial-output SAR ADC with on-chip system clock (TLC1549 pin compatible)
device.note: slas071c.pdf (SLAS071C) p.1 pinout (D/P), p.3 terminal functions and detailed description, p.4-5 Table 1 modes 1-6, p.7 recommended operating conditions, p.9 operating characteristics (tconv, td(I/O-DATA), tPZH, tPHZ)

pages: p.1 (pinout), p.3 (terminal functions, detailed description), p.4-5 (modes), p.7 (ROC), p.9 (timing)
notModeled: analog input and REF+/REF- span (the result is always the 0 V code 000h)

p.3: DATA OUT drives the MSB of the PREVIOUS conversion at CS fall, the next bits on the following 9 I/O CLOCK falling edges, low from the 10th falling edge; the pipelined result is invisible with the constant 0 V code
the conversion starts at the 10th I/O CLOCK falling edge and takes up to 21 us (internal clock); the model starts it at CS rise (mode 1/3/5), without a data-input pin there is no clock counter
modes 2, 4 and 6 (CS held low continuously, MSB appearing within 21 us of the 10th clock or at the 16th clock) are not modeled: every transfer must begin with a CS falling edge
CS transitions are recognized only after 1.425 us (setup plus two internal clock edges); CS low within 9 us of the 10th clock aborts the conversion
the 11th clock must rise within 9.5 us of the 10th falling edge in 11-16 clock transfers (sync loss otherwise)
I/O CLOCK up to 2.1 MHz, 190 ns min high/low
variants: TLV1549C/I/M share the datasheet; the M-grade FK/JG packages are not in the skeleton.
